description: This file defines a Java interface for representing requests for domain-specific acknowledgements with optional filtering, including methods for creation, deserialization, and serialization, along with schema details and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: FilteredAcknowledgementRequest
classes.description: An interface representing a request for acknowledgements with optional filtering, providing methods for JSON conversion and retrieval of included acknowledgement requests and filter.

classes.name: FilteredAcknowledgementRequest.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing static definitions of JSON fields used within FilteredAcknowledgementRequest, such as 'includes' and 'filter'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of FilteredAcknowledgementRequest with specified includes and optional filter.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a FilteredAcknowledgementRequest from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncludes
methods.description: Retrieves the set of acknowledgement requests included in the filter.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the optional filter string applied to the acknowledgements.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the request to a JsonObject, with optional parameters for schema version and field selection.
